verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a domain, hosting and commerce platform like GoDaddy, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers choosing a storage region or residency for account, DNS, or commerce data. The docs cover only domain search, registration, DNS, renewals, locks, forwarding, auth, and commerce APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
